milestones.label: First admissions round opens
milestones.note: The round aimed at applicants from abroad, carrying most English-taught programmes. The 2027 catalogue becomes visible here. University Admissions tells IB students who have not finished the Diploma not to apply in this round.

milestones.label: First round closes, and rankings lock
milestones.note: Also the last day to change how your choices are ranked. Not your round as a May 2027 IB candidate unless the programme admits on predicted grades (Stockholm School of Economics does).

milestones.label: First round supporting documents and fee exemption
milestones.note: Also the deadline to document EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship for fee exemption. Five months before IB results are published, which is the problem to solve early rather than in January.

milestones.label: Second round closes, and rankings lock
milestones.note: The round University Admissions tells a May 2027 IB candidate to use. Many English-taught programmes are no longer open in it, so check your programme is before you plan on it.

milestones.label: Second round — document your EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption)
milestones.note: Eight days after the application deadline. An application whose fee exemption is not documented is not processed.

milestones.label: Second round supporting documents
milestones.note: Everything except the IB results themselves, which have until 5 July.

milestones.label: University Admissions needs your IB results (recipient code UHR)
milestones.note: University Admissions gives IB/EB students completing their studies this spring until 5 July. Your coordinator releases your results through the IB Result Service. This falls before the site's IB results day of 6 July; ask University Admissions how a result released on the 6th is handled.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After every first-round date. In the second round your results are expected by University Admissions on 5 July; results follow on 9 July.

milestones.label: Reply to your second-round offer
milestones.note: A place you do not reply to is a place you lose.
